listing.name: Pokémon Gold (Gen1Recomp / G1R Deluxe)
listing.summary: Import your own matching US English Pokémon Gold original in the official Gen1Recomp player. Setup, Play, updates and saves stay with the upstream player.

steps.title: Import your original
steps.instruction: Use your own canonical US English 2 MiB Pokémon Gold Game Boy Color ROM, SHA-1 d8b8a3600a465308c9953dfa04f0081c05bdcb94. Import it with the upstream player and verify it has accepted this edition. The upstream player validates the ROM. Import may start the game directly.

steps.title: Select the upstream player
steps.instruction: Use the official upstream release. On Windows x64 extract the entire Windows ZIP and select gen1recomp.exe and its containing directory. On Linux x86-64 make the official AppImage executable and select it and its containing directory. On either Mac architecture keep the complete gen1recomp.app bundle. Select Contents/MacOS/love and the Contents/MacOS folder.

steps.title: Add the game and play
steps.instruction: Review the one literal argument --game=gold and save the registration. Start the selected player with Play. Gen II gameplay is in development upstream.

steps.title: Keep your game data
steps.instruction: The upstream player owns import, runtime replacement and the shared profile. Keep your original separate and retain imports, saves, settings, mods and the actual shared profile locations. Removal clears the Portcove registration only. Launch and update Flatpak and mobile copies through upstream.

warnings: Keep the original outside the player’s working data. Gen1Recomp owns the imported data and profile.
